title: StationMetadata
description: Canonical station metadata used for dashboard filtering, grouping, and experiment comparisons.

stationId.description: Unique station identifier used across telemetry, analytics, and operator views.

stationName.description: Human-readable station label for dashboard lists.

buildingId.description: Stable building identifier used for filtering and rollups.

floorId.description: Stable floor identifier used for grouping and leaderboard comparisons.

locationLabel.description: Operator-facing location descriptor such as food court or exit lobby.

signageVariant.description: Signage experiment variant for before or after and A/B comparisons.

layoutVariant.description: Station layout or placement variant used for comparison analysis.

activeRulesPresetId.description: Identifier of the rules preset currently active on the station.
